key_idea: Beginner time is the sum of step durations and expert time is the longest (critical) path in the dependency DAG; sort recipes by the ratio.
sketch: Steps arrive in topological order, so finish[step] = duration + max finish of its dependencies can be computed on the fly with a name->time map; expert time is the max finish, beginner time the sum. Sort recipes by sum/expert, comparing fractions by cross-multiplication in 64-bit (values up to 5e7, products 2.5e15) to avoid float ties. O(total dependencies * log). Multiple answers are accepted on ties: samples 1 and 2 match exactly, sample 3 is an exact tie (both ratios 1) where my order differs from the printed one but is equally valid, confirmed by hand.
